title: Monocenter prospective registry to evaluate real life data of survival, treatment and consequences from changes of the WHO classification of Brain Tumors and molecular characteristics with regard to reclassification or prognosis in a German hospital - GLIO-REAL
summary: The registry is to study in one center (monocenter) from date of diagnosis (prospective) real life data of survival, treatment and consequences from changes of the WHO classification of Brain Tumors and molecular characteristics with regard to reclassification or prognosis in a German hospital - GLIO-REAL
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of spinal cord, cranial nerves and other parts of central nervous system

interventions.name: It will be collected all relevant diagnostic and therapeutic information until death

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
astrocytoma, glioma, oligodendroglioma, glioblastoma
Exclusion criteria:
none
